$comment: SH1250: the showcase's feature-to-page matrix, read by cli/test/showcase-matrix.test.mjs and by SH1255's coverage test. Every manifest features key, every MCP tool and every curator surface maps to a page path from `pages`, or to an exclusion with its reason. Paths are relative to a locale root.

pages./: Home: the season's lead story, three featured trails, the next guided trips
pages./trails: Listing: every trail as a card, filtered by region and difficulty
pages./trails/costa-do-vento: Detail: a coastal trail, with map, gallery, guide and related stories
pages./guides/iara-quintela: A guide's profile, with the trails and trips she leads
pages./trips: Guided trips with dates and price, the commerce-shaped listing
pages./trips/costa-do-vento-four-days: One trip, with an enquiry form
pages./members: A page only signed-in members see
pages./search: Site search over trails, stories and guides
pages./about: The brand and the fact that it is fictional
pages./contact: A site form whose submissions land as drafts
pages./tour: The feature tour: how this site was built, and the index of what each page shows
pages./tour/agent: How an agent discovers and reads this site in one call
pages./tour/writes: How the agent wrote it: plans, batches, idempotent applies
pages./tour/verification: How the agent proved it without anyone looking
pages./tour/curator: What the curator did: edit in place, review, schedule, restore
pages./tour/files: The same site as files on disk
pages./tour/delivery: The same content over REST, GraphQL and webhooks
pages./tour/media: Where each image is used and what it is
pages./tour/replication: How an existing site becomes an authorable one

multiTenant.exclude: An operator setting: one install serves several tenants, and a visitor only ever sees one

oidc.exclude: Sign-in provider configuration; the showcase signs members in with local accounts

rateLimit.exclude: An operator budget on CDA tokens, with nothing a visitor could see

signedImageUrls.exclude: Off by default, and turning it on for a demo would only make its image URLs longer

searchIndexing.exclude: Needs a Viglet Turing instance, which a fresh install does not have

usageMeter.exclude: Per-tenant metering for the operator; a demo visitor has no bill to read
